text:
Your anxiety isn't a mental illness. It's an empty life having feelings.

You stay home. You scroll. You repeat. Then wonder why your nervous system is screaming.

It's not broken. It's working perfectly. Your body is telling you: this life isn't real. Nothing you do matters.

The only cure is real things. Money in the bank. Muscle on your frame. People who actually know you. A goal so big it scares you.

Not pills. Not affirmations. Actual wins.

Build your life and watch your mind heal itself.
caption:
Your mind isn't sick. Your life is empty. Fill it with achievement and watch the anxiety fade away.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
